extracted.intended_audience: organizations, entrepreneurs, researchers, and others seeking grants or venture investments from the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative
extracted.subtask_short: CZI grants and ventures funding overview
extracted.subtask_description: High-level overview of the types of funding CZI provides (grants, venture investments, tools/products, capacity building) and the basic priorities that funding should support. Useful for prospective applicants and partners to understand alignment expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support our missions in Science, Education, and Community
rubrics_metrics.description: We make grants to people and organizations working in support of our missions in Science, Education — as well as giving directed to our local community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grants are intended for individuals and organizations whose work aligns with CZI's mission areas (Science, Education, Community). See area-specific pages (Science, Education, Community) for more details and funding opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invest in impact-focused companies developing transformative solutions
rubrics_metrics.description: We invest venture capital in companies around the world that are developing transformative solutions to the issues at the heart of CZI’s mission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Venture investments target companies whose products or services meaningfully address core CZI mission problems and demonstrate potential global impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prefer companies building scalable, sustainable businesses
rubrics_metrics.description: Venture investments are made in companies that are building scalable, sustainable businesses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CZI looks for business models and teams capable of scaling impact over time while maintaining financial and operational sustainability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build tools and products that can be scaled and given away for free
rubrics_metrics.description: CZI builds tools and products that we can scale and give away for free.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where CZI creates technology or products, priority is on solutions that can be scaled broadly and distributed freely to maximize public benefit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support capacity building to achieve progress across mission areas
rubrics_metrics.description: CZI supports capacity building to achieve progress across our work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funding may be used for efforts that strengthen organizations' ability to deliver impact (e.g., institutional capacity, infrastructure, training) across Science, Education, and Community initiatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding may come from multiple CZI entities
rubrics_metrics.description: CZI is composed of four funding entities: the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, LLC; the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative Foundation (a 501(c)(3) private foundation); the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative Donor-Advised Fund (DAF) at the Silicon Valley Community Foundation; and Chan Zuckerberg Initiative Advocacy (a 501(c)(4) organization).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prospective applicants or partners should be aware that grants, directed giving, and investments may originate from different legal entities within CZI; consult area-specific guidance or contacts to determine the appropriate funding vehicle.
